data.summary:
Senior Product Owner with 17+ years of experience in payments and transaction banking, covering the complete project lifecycle from requirement gathering to production support. Strong expertise in SWIFT messaging and ISO 20022 migration, including MT to MX conversion, pacs, pain, and camt message types, and the MT-MX coexistence period. Hands-on experience with Faster Payments, high-value, instant, and real- time payment processing. Skilled in converting business vision into a clear, well-structured product backlog, including epics, features, and INVEST-compliant user stories that development teams can execute directly. Recently managed enterprise platform strategy the Founder/Chairman, CIO, CTO, and EVP on governance, and roadmap decisions.
in
the United States, worked closely with
Comfortable working across both business and technical areas, including preparing BRD, FRD, and FSD documents, mapping data between MT and MX formats, reviewing API and integration designs (REST, JSON, XML, message queues), and creating process models using BPMN, UML, and sequence diagrams. Good knowledge of clearing and settlement systems, including Faster Payments, CHAPS, SEPA SCT/SDD, RTGS, TARGET2 and NEFT. Combines this domain knowledge with strong Agile/SAFe delivery skills and stakeholder management to deliver high-quality, compliant platform outcomes.
TECHNICAL & DOMAIN TOOLKIT
Payments Domain: SWIFT MT (MT103, MT202, MT202 COV) & MX, SWIFT gpi, ISO 20022 (pacs.008/.009, pain.001, camt.053/.054), CBPR+, nostro/vostro reconciliation, correspondent banking, Faster Payments, cross- border & high-value payments Clearing & Settlement: CHAPS, SEPA SCT / SDD, RTGS, TARGET2, NEFT, STP optimization, payment investigations & exception handling PO Craft: Product vision & roadmaps, epics / features / user stories, INVEST, acceptance criteria & Gherkin, story mapping, backlog grooming, MoSCoW & WSJF prioritization, BRD / FRD / FSD, gap & impact analysis, traceability, UI/UX collaboration (Figma) Agile Delivery: Scrum, SAFe, sprint planning, velocity, PI planning, JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps Analysis & Modeling: BPMN, UML, wireframes & workflow diagrams, data mapping & lineage, JSON, XML, SQL, message queues, system-log analysis, RCA Quality & Governance: SIT / UAT planning & execution, regression, defect triage, RACI, risk & dependency management, regulatory & compliance alignment, sanctions / AML awareness

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Clean Harbors Senior Product Owner | June 2025 – June 2026
Owned the enterprise platform's product vision and roadmap, aligning epics and release plans with long- term business strategy and OKRs.
Worked directly with the Founder/Chairman, CIO, CTO, and EVP on platform strategy, governance, and investment decisions.
Converted executive direction into a structured, WSJF-prioritized backlog of epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Partnered with architects and engineering leads on solution design, API contracts, and non-functional requirements.
Coordinated with the UI/UX team in Figma to review screen designs, ensure they met business requirements, and get final sign-off from the Founder/Chairman.
Managed platform-level risks, cross-team dependencies, and key decisions using a RACI-based governance model.
Maintained sprint cadence, backlog refinement, and release readiness across multiple delivery teams while meeting quality and performance SLAs.
Wipro Technologies Senior Consultant | May 2024 – April 2025
Led ISO 20022 migration analysis, including MT to MX field mapping (pacs/pain/camt), data lineage tracing, and translation rules for SWIFT and Faster Payments.
Worked with subject matter experts to gather and model requirements using BPMN and use cases, converting them into BRD/FRD documents and INVEST-compliant user stories.
Wrote acceptance criteria and Gherkin scenarios, and supported QA with SIT/UAT test cases, defect triage, and regression testing.
Performed root cause analysis on production defects using system logs and message flow reviews, working with engineering teams to resolve issues.
Managed backlog grooming, story mapping, and sprint prioritization in a fast-paced Agile environment, balancing business needs with regulatory deadlines.
Analyzed transaction data and STP metrics to identify improvement opportunities for the payment platform.
Optimum Infosystem Manager – Business Analyst | June 2021 – May 2024
Led end-to-end product discovery and requirements engineering for multiple payments and core-banking 
Team Lead – Payment Investigations | January 2016 – November 2016
Led and mentored a team of payment investigators, maintaining SLA compliance and accuracy for high- value SWIFT payments.
Managed escalations, risk tracking, and controls for payment exceptions, repairs, recalls, and sanctions/AML holds.
Acted as the main point of coordination between operations and management, identifying process improvement and STP opportunities.
RBS Business Services Senior Process Associate – SWIFT Payments | June 2008 – December 2015
Processed end-to-end SWIFT payments, including MT103, MT202, and MT202 COV message types, in a live transaction banking environment.
Gained hands-on experience with global payment systems, including CHAPS, SEPA, RTGS, NEFT, and TARGET.
Handled payment investigations, repairs, and nostro reconciliations, identifying root causes and fixing process gaps.
Contributed to improvements that increased straight-through-processing (STP) rates and reduced manual repairs.

projects.
Drove ISO 20022 migration programs, including SWIFT MT-to-MX transformation, XSD schema validation, and canonical data model alignment.
Defined feature sets, story maps, and prioritized backlogs aligned with platform capabilities and compliance requirements.
Worked with product owners, architects, and delivery teams to plan roadmap sequencing and integration design.
Managed competing priorities across multiple Agile teams while maintaining delivery speed and quality.
BNY Mellon Lead Business Analyst | January 2018 – April 2021
Worked as a Business Analyst on a document data-capture system used for mortgage document processing.
Gathered and analyzed business requirements to consolidate two separate applications into a single unified system, reducing duplicate effort for end users.
Facilitated requirement workshops with business users and technology teams to identify gaps between the two existing systems and define the future-state solution.
Wrote detailed user stories with acceptance criteria to translate business requirements into clear, actionable specifications for the development team.
Supported UAT planning and execution, working with business users to validate the new system before go-live.
Designed workflow enhancements for exception handling, including a process to flag and route poor- quality document images for rework.
Defined a duplicate-detection check to ensure only clean, accurate records moved forward for processing.
